en: Improved Bedrock and Vertex AI sessions to switch to an older available model of the same tier, instead of failing, when an admin removes access to the default model; session titles and summaries now fall back with it
zh: 改进 Bedrock 和 Vertex AI session：当管理员移除对默认模型的访问权限时，改为切换到同层级中较旧的可用模型，而不是失败；session 标题和摘要也会随之回退
